title: Core Duo #49
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, two women in a single row.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 2 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Korean woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair porcelain skin, two round red yeonji blush circles painted on the cheeks and a small round red gonji dot at the centre of the forehead, clearly defined dark brows, softly lined eyes with bright real catchlights, small vivid red lips, a serene, dignified expression, sultry, cool ash-brown hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Polish Bolesławiec pottery — a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs, wide white bands following every deep crease, dense peacock-eye dot motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: both arms raised overhead.

Left woman's footwear: extreme white needle heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Russian woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, very fair, cool skin, sculpted feathered dark brows, a precise winged liner, soft taupe eyeshadow, long lashes, large pale eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour and a bright highlighter along the cheekbones and nose bridge, glossy nude-pink lips, a cold, striking expression, bold and confident, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain — a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.

Right woman's footwear: extreme gold platform stiletto studded boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 2, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 landscape 8K.
